hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that captures swap fees (1–5%) entirely in ETH and distributes them instantly per-trade. Supports five fee-distribution modes: direct recipient payouts with optional buyback-and-burn, stock rewards (buys a configured stock token for holders), ETH staking payouts (robin mode), weighted lottery draws, or auto-liquidity provisioning around the current price.
